mode: Independent static reading controls, not executed workflow/model decisions

controls.source_expected: Record low uncertainty with observable clear outcome/check/resource reasons, perform the bounded correction and verification; no material user choice means no question.
controls.finding: Supported by beginning-of-request paragraph and existing reversible-baseline rule.

controls.case: Potentially missing but locally retrievable configuration fact
controls.source_expected: Inspect retrievable facts before escalating; do not ask a user to provide a fact already available through authorized bounded inspection. Independent safe work continues.
controls.finding: Explicitly supported; no new global stop is introduced.

controls.case: Remaining choice materially changes scope, cost, reversibility or acceptance
controls.source_expected: Ask the user for the smallest useful options and recommendation; preserve independent authorized groundwork while that decision is pending.
controls.finding: Explicit decision trigger in execution paragraph; existing pending-material-bar and unresolved-priority language preserves the user decision.

controls.case: Worker, retry or follow-up encounters the already-settled shared USD20 change-request ceiling
controls.source_expected: Reuse the settled shared allowance; do not repeat the budget question or treat it as a new per-worker allowance. Unknown usage is not converted into a claimed observed remaining balance.
controls.finding: Shared-allowance sentence and unchanged budget ancestry/unknown-telemetry clauses support this. No actual dollar meter or automated enforcement is claimed.
